props.label: Top
props.html:
Support

Help & support, whenever you need it.

Already a Nifty Websites Australia client? Raise a support ticket through your Partner Portal and our team will take care of it — website changes, hosting, email, billing and more, all tracked in one place.

Raise a support ticket Billing Account Access
Ticketing powered by
How it works

Support in three simple steps.

All support requests are managed through your Niftyhub.ai Partner Portal, so nothing gets lost in an inbox.

1

Log in to your Partner Portal

Head to your Niftyhub.ai Partner Portal and sign in with the account details we set up for you.

2

Submit your ticket

Tell us what you need — a change, a fix, a question. Add any details, links or screenshots so we can action it quickly.

3

We handle it & keep you posted

Your request is logged, assigned and tracked. You will see updates and replies right inside the portal until it is resolved.

What we can help with

Here to keep your website running beautifully.

Not sure which category your request fits? Just raise a ticket and we will point it to the right place.

Website changes & updates

Text edits, new pages, images, sections or tweaks to your live website.

Hosting, domains & SSL

Anything to do with your hosting, domain name, DNS, SSL or site uptime.

Business email

Help with mailboxes, email setup, forwarding and delivery issues.

Billing & invoices

Questions about your invoices, hosting renewal, Care Plan or payment details.

Something not working

Report a bug, a broken form, a display issue or a site that is down.

SEO & Care Plan requests

Requests that fall under your Care Plan — ongoing edits, SEO and improvements.

Your Partner Portal

All support is handled in your Partner Portal.

Log a ticket, add details, and follow every reply and status update in one place. It is the fastest way to reach our team and the best way to keep a clear history of everything we have done for your website.

Go to the Partner Portal Billing Account Access
Ticketing powered by
What to expect

Clear, reliable support.

Fast response

We aim to respond to new tickets within one business day, Monday to Friday (AEST).

Care Plan priority

Care Plan clients get priority handling and included hours for ongoing changes and improvements.

Tracked & transparent

Every ticket is logged in your portal, so you always know its status and history.

Quick links

Find what you need faster.

Not a client yet?

How to join the Nifty Hub ticketing system.

Our ticketing system runs through Nifty Hub and is exclusively for Nifty Websites Australia clients. Becoming a client is the first step — and once you are, your access is set up automatically.

Here’s how it works

  1. 1

    Send us your details

    Fill in the form with your contact details so we can set up your account.

  2. 2

    You become a client

    We get you onboarded. Ticketing access through Nifty Hub is included by default with every client.

  3. 3

    You get your invite

    Once you’re a client, you’re automatically sent an email request to join the Nifty Hub ticketing system and set up your login.

Good to know: by default, as soon as you become a client you’ll be emailed an invitation to join the Nifty Hub ticketing system — no extra steps needed.

Prefer to talk first? Call us on 1300 164 389.

Request your account

Send us your details and we’ll get you set up as a client, then invite you to the ticketing system.

Private & secure. We reply within one business day.

data.name: Nifty Websites Australia

data.name: Web Design Agency Australia | Nifty Websites Australia
data.description: Australian web design agency that builds websites designed to rank, convert and drive growth, with a complete SEO build included on every site.

makesOffer.name: Website with a complete SEO build included
makesOffer.description: Every website includes an SEO build set up for you, covering SEO-optimised content, schema markup, technical SEO implementation and Google Search Console and Analytics setup.

mainEntity.name: What does Nifty Websites Australia do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia is an Australian web design agency that builds strategic websites for small and growing businesses. Every site is designed to rank in search, convert visitors into enquiries and drive growth, and includes a complete SEO build set up at launch.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the free SEO build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every website includes SEO-optimised content, schema markup on every page, technical SEO implementation, and Google Search Console and Analytics setup, configured for you at launch.

mainEntity.name: How much does a website cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty Websites Australia builds Starter sites from $699 and Professional sites from $1,499 on its own Nifty platform. eCommerce and custom builds on WordPress, Shopify or other platforms are quoted on enquiry. Every website includes a complete SEO build and a fixed quote before any work begins.
